groq.catalogNotes: Groq documents separate English and Saudi-Arabic Orpheus models with disjoint six-voice catalogs; only the English model supports bracketed vocal directions.

canopylabs/orpheus-v1-english.description: Orpheus v1 English — expressive low-latency cloud TTS
canopylabs/orpheus-v1-english.pricingNotes: Groq lists canopylabs/orpheus-v1-english Text-To-Speech as billed at $22 / 1M characters. Stored as a single character rate to avoid double-counting input text.

canopylabs/orpheus-arabic-saudi.description: Orpheus Saudi Arabic — authentic Saudi-dialect cloud TTS
canopylabs/orpheus-arabic-saudi.pricingNotes: Groq lists canopylabs/orpheus-arabic-saudi Text-To-Speech at $40 / 1M characters. The model accepts only its six Saudi-Arabic voices and does not support English-model vocal directions.
